This specific role requires strong leadership skills, astute attention to detail, creative problem solving, and a collaborative motivation to achieve mission success across a diverse, geographically separated stakeholder team.

You must be able to work independently, planning, organizing and coordinating programmatic actions across various engineering, financial, legal, security, public affairs and contracting offices, both internal and external to Space Systems Command (SSC), USSF.

Strong communication skills are critical, both oral and written, with a focus on clear, concise and technically accurate dialogue that synchronizes efforts across more than 30 government and contractor organizations.

In addition, the duties of this position require the ability to analyze, negotiate, and resolve complex issues while maintaining good working relationships.

Finally, as part of our government team, you are expected to assist in the training, development, mentorship, and motivation of junior civilian and military program managers as they join the team.

Ideal Candidate: Experience with Government Space acquisitions, with government acquisition program offices, and contracts for military space segments; minimum program management practitioner (level 2) DIAWIA certification; minimum bachelor's degree, preferred master's degree.

Independent execution; Leadership; Briefing/clear, concise communication; Critical Thinking; Organization and Planning; Collaboration; Attention to Detail; Team Building. Key Skills and Abilities: 1.

Comprehensive knowledge of the applicable principles, concepts, policies, and laws; functions, programs, and systems applicable to the duties of logistics contracts and program management and material support; sources, responsibilities, and means for providing assistance and advice to resolve logistics contracts and program management problems; and all aspects of logistics contracts and program management support. 2.

Comprehensive knowledge of government and private industry policies and practices related to business management, industrial management, financial systems, technical concepts, and production practices.

Ability to gather, analyze, and evaluate a variety of program information, such as commercial business practices, market conditions, offer acceptability, contractor acceptability, contractor responsibility and/or performance to determine acquisition strategy and sources. 3.

Knowledge of the missions, roles, functions, organizational structures, and operation of the Department of Defense, and entities that govern, interface with, and/or influence management control of proposed and ongoing service contracts. 4.

Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, clearly, concisely, with technical accuracy and to use computers and a variety of software programs and databases, gather and analyze a variety of program information, make sound judgments concerning program progress, and effectively communicate recommendations orally and in writing to higher organizational management and contractors. 5.

Ability to establish and maintain good relationships with individuals and groups within the office as well as outside the immediate work unit and to be persuasive in representing the best interests of the government when dealing with personnel with highly divergent points of view. 6.

Ability to plan, organize, analyze problems, translate complex information, make appropriate judgments, evaluate options, conduct research, summarize results, make appropriate recommendations, and manage critical aspects of service contract requirements as related to the assigned functional area and meet deadlines.

You will provide the organizational support needed to ensure that our strategic recommendations are tracked, documented, and moved toward a final decision.
About Arabian Private Holdings
Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred page methodology deck.

They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome.

Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for significant family groups and government entities. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis over traditional office overhead.

Support our principals in gathering research and data related to the logistics sector to help form a clear view on client challenges.

Monitor project risks or delays and communicate them clearly to the responsible partners.
Assist in the preparation of governance documents and strategy materials for board level presentations.
Track communication between our firm and client representatives to maintain a clear record of decisions made.
Support the refinement of client operating models by documenting current processes and proposed changes.
What we are looking for A logical mindset and the ability to organize complex information into clear, actionable steps.
Strong writing skills with a focus on precision and the ability to communicate ideas without using corporate jargon.
A high level of attention to detail when reviewing documents and project schedules.
Curiosity about how large holding companies and regional logistics firms function at a governance level.
The ability to work independently and manage your own tasks effectively in a remote setting.
Basic familiarity with digital tools for project tracking or a strong willingness to learn our specific methods.
How we work
We operate as a fully remote firm, which allows us to focus on the clarity of our thinking rather than the logistics of an office. This model requires a high degree of professional maturity and trust. We value intellectual honesty and direct communication, where the quality of an idea is more important than the title of the person who suggests it.

As an entry level member of the team, you will receive direct mentoring from our principals, gaining exposure to how significant corporate decisions are made and executed. We prioritize high impact work on a small number of mandates, ensuring that our team can remain focused on results rather than simple activity.

Competitive pay that is attractive for the market and reflective of the importance of this role.
A permanent, fully remote position that offers professional autonomy and flexibility.
Mentorship from experienced principals who are leaders in the fields of governance and corporate strategy.
A professional environment that values sober analysis and clear communication over corporate theater.

We are seeking a Senior Project Manager with a mandatory Fintech background to spearhead the delivery of our Mobile app ecosystem (crypto wallet, card, and investment product line ). This is a role for a hands-on leader who can move seamlessly between a high-level roadmap and a deep-dive technical discussion.
You will lead cross-functional squads, owning the delivery lifecycle from technical discovery to production.
Mission
Transform engineering delivery into a predictable "Black Box."
Ensure an accuracy rate of over 80% in "Plan vs. Fact" and liberate C-level executives from operational micromanagement.
What you'll actually do
1. Predictability & Delivery Governance
Own the Forecast: You are responsible for the realism of our deadlines. You don't just record estimates; you facilitate decomposition and challenge "3-hour" estimates that should be "3 days."
Jira as Source of Truth: Maintain perfect hygiene in project tooling. Ensure blockers are surfaced immediately, and progress is transparent to all stakeholders without manual pings.

Bridge the Gap: Orchestrate the team to translate the CPO's high-level vision into detailed, actionable User Stories with clear Acceptance Criteria.
Gatekeeping: Ensure no task enters a sprint without being "Ready for Development," preventing "dumb product/tech decisions" at the source.
3. Team Dynamics & Facilitation
The Buffer: Act as a constructive bridge between the team members. Resolve friction and ensure technical debates result in actionable plans.
Operational Discipline: Push the team to maintain tracking and documentation standards.

Technical Savvy: A background in QA, Analyst, or Engineering is highly preferred. You must understand APIs, Backend architecture, and CI/CD enough to "smell" unrealistic technical claims.
Assertive Mindset: The ability to say "No" to raw requirements and "No" to half-baked estimates. You are the "Sheriff" of the process.
Pragmatic Agile: Experience adapting frameworks (Scrum/Kanban) to small, fast-moving teams. You care about delivery, not just ceremonies.
Experience: 5+ years in IT Project/Delivery Management in Fintech or regulated environments.
Languages: Professional English and Russian (required).
Key Success Metric (90 Days)
Predictability: The team hits its committed sprint goals with <20% deviation in time estimates.
Autonomy: The C-Level is no longer involved in validating individual technical tasks.
Work fully remote as part of an agile, international team reshaping the future of finance.

The clinical pharmacy specialist (CPS) functions at the highest level of clinical practice, works independently under their scope of practice as defined by the individual medical center to directly care for patients.

A CPS plays a defined role in budgetary execution and serves as a mid-level provider who functions to initiate, modify or discontinue medication therapy and as a consultant for intensive medication therapy management services.

This includes, but is not limited to, the following: designing, implementing, assessing, monitoring and documenting therapeutic plans utilizing the most effective, least toxic and most economical medication treatments; helping achieve positive patient centric outcomes through direct and indirect interactions with patients, providers, and interdisciplinary teams in assigned areas; performing physical assessments; and ordering laboratory and other tests to help determine efficacy and toxicity of medication therapy.

Advanced skill in monitoring and assessing the outcome of drug therapies, including physical assessment and interpretation of laboratory and other diagnostic parameters.

Qui sommes\-nous ?
Alpenda est un acteur de référence de la construction en Suisse romande depuis plus de 100 ans.

Forte de près de 200 collaborateurs, l'entreprise accompagne ses clients dans leurs projets de construction et de rénovation grâce à une approche globale couvrant la conception, la planification, la réalisation et la modernisation des bâtiments, avec une attention particulière portée à la qualité, à l'innovation et à la durabilité.

Filiale suisse du groupe DEMATHIEU BARD, Alpenda poursuit le développement de projets d'envergure. Ce lien renforce les synergies et les expertises des deux entreprises tout en préservant l'identité, la proximité et l'ancrage local qui font la force d'Alpenda.

Vous rejoignez la Direction Exploitation, en charge du pilotage des chantiers de l'ensemble des projets d'Alpenda. Sa mission est de garantir un haut niveau d'exigence en matière de qualité, de sécurité, de respect de l'environnement, ainsi que de maîtrise des délais et des budgets.

Nos équipes spécialisées interviennent sur des projets variés, en construction neuve comme en rénovation, dans les secteurs résidentiel et fonctionnel.

Reconnus pour notre expertise dans la réalisation de projets haut de gamme, nous accordons une importance particulière à l'accompagnement de nos clients, à la transparence de nos échanges et à l'excellence de nos prestations. En tant que Chef de Projet, vous assurez la gestion technique et le bon déroulement du projet.

Vous veillez également à la bonne représentation de l’entreprise et êtes un véritable leader de terrain, reconnu pour votre polyvalence et votre capacité à fédérer les différents intervenants.

About Wolt
At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Every contact that reaches a customer support agent, and every credit issued to customers, represents a defect somewhere in our system. This role exists to help find those defects, trace them to their source, and work with the teams responsible to eliminate them at a systemic level.
This is a high impact senior program management role within the EMEA Customer Experience organisation, reporting to the Director of Defect Elimination and Customer Experience. The Senior Program Manager is accountable for turning customer experience signals from Wolt and/or Deliveroo markets into clear, actionable insight, and for driving the resulting fixes through to resolution with partner teams.
What you’ll be doing
You will own the delivery of the defect elimination program across EMEA, including application of the defect driver taxonomy to identify where defect rate concentrates, and where customer outcomes are worst. You will build a clear, prioritised list of issues for partner teams to work through.
You will represent the voice of the customer in the rooms where decisions get made about your markets. That means preparing and presenting data in product reviews, weekly/monthly business reviews and planning sessions, so the cost of poor customer experience is concrete and attributable, and so partner teams understand what is being asked of them and why.
You will build working relationships with partner teams in engineering, marketplace operations, courier operations, and finance, and you will track the fixes they commit to through to completion. You will feed results back into the program so everyone can see what worked, and to ensure defects are eliminated for good.
You will maintain and improve the data infrastructure and reporting that underpins this work, ensuring customer experience insights are credible, available and actionable.
Our humble expectations
The right person for this role has spent time inside a large-scale customer experience or operations function, and has direct experience translating customer defects through identification, root cause analysis and resolution. They are comfortable working with imperfect data, and they know how to build a credible case when the evidence is directional rather than conclusive.
Strong analytical instincts are essential. This person needs to know what questions to ask of the data and whether the answers make sense. Prior exposure to a successful voice of the customer (VoC) program is critical.
There is a meaningful cross-functional dimension to the role. This person will spend real time getting other teams to prioritise work that benefits the customer but may compete with other priorities. That requires good judgement, clear communication, and the ability to build trust quickly with people outside their reporting line.
The role also requires the ability to drive results in a dynamic and ambiguous landscape. The right person will combine introducing structure and rigor, while being agile and responsive to changing priorities and emerging issues.
This is a high impact and high visibility role, with the opportunity to interact with stakeholders and teams across the full customer lifecycle. The role will also span across 40 EMEA Roo & Wolt markets, meaning there is an opportunity to drive financial and customer experience results at scale.
Next steps
You will first meet with our Talent Acquisition team to understand role and company fit. Then, you will meet with the Hiring Manager who will talk through your relevant experience and ask you competency based questions that assess your suitability for the role.

The third stage is an assignment, where you will be given a business problem to think through, and present back to the team. If successful, there may be a final conversation with a more senior stakeholder. Throughout all stages, you will have plenty of opportunities to ask any questions about the role, team or company.
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

The Agile Delivery Manager (ADM) is accountable for delivering business value across one or more agile teams, specifically in support of the organization’s digital transformation.

Acting as a servant leader and connector between strategic intent and operational execution, the ADM sits at the bridge point between the product/feature layer (Product Owners, Business Analysts, Business Owners) and the delivery layer (Engineering Managers, Developers, QA, and the Scrum Masters who own team-level performance).

The ADM ensures that delivery aligns with product roadmaps, value streams, and enterprise priorities.
This role is not about managing tasks—it’s about enabling flow, clarity, and measurable outcomes that advance the organization’s customer and business goals. The ADM owns the health and predictability of the Program Increment (PI): making sure it is planned well, tracked honestly, and delivered against — while escalating risks and dependencies before they become blockers. .

s.h: The role is responsible for the following results
s.t:
Delivery Flow and Value
Consistently leveraging lean and agile practices to achieve outcomes, not just complete output.

Use performance and progress data to increase transparency and predictability in meeting commitments to the business.
Facilitate the adoption and evolution of agile practices to continuously improve how the organization produces high quality and high value outcomes.

Facilitate scaled/cross-team agile events (e.g., PI Planning, System Demo, Inspect & Adapt, Scrum of Scrums) so they are productive and time-boxed, setting a consistent standard of effectiveness across teams. Team-level ceremonies remain owned by Scrum Masters. Ensure delivery standards and definitions of done are applied consistently across the teams.
Enablement & Coaching

Guide continuous improvement through retrospectives, delivery health checks, and root-cause analysis at the multi-team and PI Levels
Build agile maturity through mentoring, modeling psychological safety, and reenforcing learning cycles.

Translate delivery progress into business impact, reporting what value was realized, not just completed.
Own upward and outward communication of delivery status, risks, and PI outcomes to executives, business owners, the Governance & Transformation Lead, and technology leadership.
Ensure the “voice of delivery” is represented in strategic planning and portfolio discussions.

PI predictability (planned vs. delivered PI objectives) across teams in scope.

## Chargé(e) de projets / Planificateur(trice) Sanitaire ##
### Notre bureau ###
**Conti & Associés Ingénieurs SA** est un bureau d-ingénieurs spécialisé dans les techniques du bâtiment **CVSER**, implanté à **Versoix (Genève)** et **Perroy (Vaud)**.
Actifs depuis 1983, nous regroupons aujourd-hui plus de 35 collaborateurs et intervenons dans les domaines suivants :
· Chauffage, ventilation et climatisation (CVC)
· Sanitaire
· Électricité
· Régulation / MCR et automatisme du bâtiment
Nous accompagnons nos clients sur l-ensemble des phases **SIA 108**, avec une activité importante sur les phases 3, 4 et 5 : études, appels d-offres, réalisation et réception des ouvrages. Nous intervenons également en phase 6 pour le suivi de l-exploitation et l-optimisation énergétique des bâtiments.
Notre activité couvre aussi les audits et diagnostics énergétiques, la physique du bâtiment, les études de faisabilité CVSER, les CECB+, les missions GED et AMOén dans le cadre du programme éco21, ainsi que les expertises techniques CVSER pour des assurances, maîtres d-ouvrage ou dans le cadre de procédures judiciaires.
### Le poste ###
Dans le cadre du développement de notre département Sanitaire, nous recherchons un(e) **Chargé(e) de projets / Planificateur(trice) Sanitaire** capable de participer à la conception et au suivi de projets variés, de l'étude jusqu'à la réalisation.
### Vos missions ###
1/ **Études et conception**
a/ Concevoir et dimensionner les installations sanitaires conformément aux normes, directives et règles de l-art applicables en Suisse.
b/ Réaliser les études des réseaux d-eau froide, eau chaude sanitaire, bouclage, eaux usées et eaux pluviales.
c/ Réaliser les calculs et dimensionnements nécessaires aux projets.
d/ Élaborer les plans, schémas de principe et détails techniques.
2/ **Plans et soumissions**
a/ Réaliser et mettre à jour les plans sanitaires sous **AutoCAD 2D**.
b/ Établir les quantitatifs et métrés nécessaires aux appels d-offres.
c/ Participer à l-élaboration des **soumissions CAN** à l-aide des outils spécifiques tels que **Plancal Nova / SNAP**.
d/ Participer à l-analyse technique des offres des entreprises.
3/ **Coordination et réalisation**
a/ Assurer la coordination technique avec les disciplines chauffage, ventilation, électricité et régulation.
b/ Participer aux séances avec les maîtres d-ouvrage, architectes, entreprises et autres mandataires.
c/ Participer au suivi de l-exécution des installations sur le terrain.
d/ Contrôler la conformité des installations avec les plans, normes et prescriptions du projet.
e/ Participer aux réceptions des installations et au suivi des réserves.
### Votre profil ###
1/ **Formation et expérience**
a/ CFC de projeteur(se) en technique du bâtiment sanitaire, technicien(ne) ES, maîtrise fédérale ou formation jugée équivalente.
b/ Expérience de plusieurs années dans un bureau d-ingénieurs, bureau d'études ou une entreprise sanitaire.
c/ Une expérience professionnelle en Suisse constitue un avantage important.
2/ **Compétences techniques**
a/ Bonne maîtrise d-**AutoCAD 2D**.
b/ Connaissance de **Plancal Nova / SNAP** et des soumissions selon le **CAN sanitaire**.
c/ Bonne connaissance des normes et prescriptions sanitaires suisses.
d/ Connaissance des prescriptions **SSIGE** et des directives techniques **Geberit**.
e/ La maîtrise de **Revit / BIM** constitue un atout.
f/ Bonne maîtrise des outils MS Office.
### Vos qualités ###

The Aviation Regulatory Project Manager performs multiple, varying, and highly complex assignments under minimal direction from a manager or senior leader.

Serves as a principal technical specialist and project manager for major regulatory, operational, and integration activities involving Unmanned Aircraft Systems, Unmanned Aircraft Traffic Management, and Advanced Air Mobility for ensuring safe and effective integration into the National Airspace System (NAS).

Applies experience and comprehensive technical knowledge of emerging aviation operations, operational practices, and regulatory requirements to conduct both regulatory and operational evaluations to support the safe integration of emerging aviation operations into the NAS.

Conducts regulatory evaluations by interpreting and assessing the applicability of existing regulations, identifying compliance requirements, and determining where emerging operational models or technologies create gaps, conflicts, or misalignments with current regulatory frameworks.

Performs operational evaluations by analyzing procedures, system interactions, workflow impacts, and safety considerations to determine how emerging aviation operations function within the NAS and to identify operational risks or procedural inconsistencies requiring mitigation.

Integrates the results of both regulatory and operational evaluations to develop technical recommendations, support rule-making activities, and inform updates to operational criteria and compliance guidance.

Possesses an understanding of new technologies and methodologies, to solve complex problems and develop improved technical processes or systems. Conducts extensive research and analysis to evaluate how new operational models, technologies, or procedures align with existing regulatory requirements.

Integrates analytical results into project deliverables that support rule-making activities, regulatory evaluations, and updates to operational criteria. Evaluates complex operational scenarios to identify gaps, conflicts, or inconsistencies in regulatory applicability, compliance requirements, or operational procedures.

Performs root-cause analysis of operational or compliance issues involving emerging aviation operations and prepares technical findings that inform regulatory updates or operational mitigations.

Uses project management principles to plan, coordinate, and execute complex regulatory and operational evaluation activities and projects involving emerging aviation operations.

Develops project plans, schedules, and milestones to guide the assessment of operational data, procedures, and system interactions; and identifies safety risks, compliance concerns, and regulatory inconsistencies requiring higher-level analysis.

Ensures that project deliverables, analytical findings, and technical recommendations meet regulatory requirements, adhere to project objectives, and align with the priorities of the major subdivision and broader organizational goals.

Monitors project progress, identifies risks or delays, and implements corrective actions to maintain schedule and quality. Tracks project performance metrics; and prepares comprehensive regulatory analyses, compliance assessments, technical reports, and operational findings as key project outputs.

Consolidates operational, regulatory, and technical information into products that support decision-making and operational integration activities. Defines, organizes, and assigns resources to accomplish large regulatory, operational, and analytical work activities. Allocates resources to accomplish large work activities within established schedules.

Works across organizational boundaries to complete complex evaluations, research activities, and support tasks within established schedules. Provides policy guidance and instruction to others, both internally and externally.

Suchst du eine Herausforderung im Umfeld von Politik und Verwaltung, am digitalen Puls der Zeit, bei einer Arbeitgeberin mit Themen so vielfältig wie das Leben?
Die Direktion der Justiz und des Innern (JI) erfüllt eine Vielfalt von Aufgaben, von A wie Archivwesen bis Z wie Zivilstandswesen. Bei uns im Generalsekretariat laufen die Fäden zusammen. Wir unterstützen die Direktionsvorsteherin und unsere Einheiten, bearbeiten Querschnittsthemen und begleiten und führen Programme und Projekte.
Im Januar 2027 tritt das revidierte Verwaltungsrechtspflegegesetz in Kraft, das vorsieht, dass Verwaltungsverfahren neu auch digital über spezielle elektronische Kanäle abgewickelt werden. Mit RRB Nr. 433/2026 wurde ein wichtiger Meilenstein für die Implementierung dieser elektronischen Kanäle im Kanton Zürich erreicht: Im Projekt VRGo wird die neue technische Lösung «VerfahrenZH» aufgebaut, welche die rechtskonforme Abwicklung von Verwaltungsverfahren ermöglicht.
Um den organisationsübergreifenden Aufbau dieser Lösung seitens der JI zu begleiten, und um im Betrieb der Lösung die Anforderungen unserer Verwaltungseinheiten fachgerecht bei den zuständigen Stellen einzubringen, suchen wir per 1. Oktober 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung im Generalsekretariat eine Person mit technischem Hintergrund als Manager/in digitale Kanäle (80 - 100 %).
### Deine Hauptaufgaben ###
* Du stehst proaktiv im Austausch mit den verfahrensführenden Stellen der JI und identifizierst, koordinierst und priorisierst ihre Anforderungen an die elektronischen Kanäle. Diese bringst du in die Projekte zu deren Weiterentwicklung und in übergreifende Digitalisierungsvorhaben ein.
* Du kennst die relevanten Fachapplikationen der JI und unterstützt allfällige Weiterentwicklungen und Anbindungen in Zusammenhang mit den elektronischen Kanälen.
* Du bist in der JI, im Kanton und im Bund mit den relevanten Stellen vernetzt und über bedeutsame Entwicklungen auf dem Laufenden.
* Du berätst und unterstützt die Verwaltungseinheiten der JI bei der weiteren Digitalisierung ihrer Verwaltungsverfahren. Dazu begleitest du die Umsetzung neuer oder weiterentwickelter Funktionalitäten aus Nutzendensicht und stehst in engem Austausch mit den Fachbereichen, Legal, IT-/Betriebsteams und weiteren Stakeholdern.
### Dein Profil ###
* Tertiäre Ausbildung (z.B. in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Betriebswirtschaft, Rechtswissenschaften), mit Erfahrung in der Digitalisierung von Prozessen, Dienstleistungen oder Kommunikationskanälen (vorzugsweise in der Verwaltung oder im juristischen Bereich)
* Ausgeprägtes Verständnis für die Bedürfnisse der Nutzenden sowie für serviceorientierte Gestaltung, stark in Koordination und Stakeholder-Management
* Schnelle Auffassungsgabe sowie eine analytische, strukturierte und konzeptionelle Arbeitsweise mit Freude an der Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung digitaler Lösungen
* Ganzheitliches Denken, hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, Eigeninitiative und hohe Eigenverantwortung mit proaktivem Arbeitsverständnis

Voici comment nous te séduisons
Nous t'offrons un poste à responsabilités dans une entreprise unique en Suisse. De plus, tu bénéficies chez nous des avantages suivants :
* Horaires de travail flexibles (42 heures par semaine)

* Environnement de travail et infrastructure modernes
* Prestations sociales progressistes et caisse de pension attractive
* Soutien financier et/ou en temps pour des formations internes ou externes

The Program Manager owns the design, execution, and continuous improvement of strategic customer programs at Elovate . This role requires a strong program management mindset — driving structure, alignment, and delivery — while also serving as a trusted partner to our municipal and agency customers. You'll ensure programs are delivered on time, meet defined outcomes, and create measurable value for both customers and the business. Job Description:

The Program Manager owns the design, execution, and continuous improvement of strategic customer programs at Elovate . This role requires a strong program management mindset — driving structure, alignment, and delivery — while also serving as a trusted partner to our municipal and agency customers. You'll ensure programs are delivered on time, meet defined outcomes, and create measurable value for both customers and the business.

Program Planning & Delivery
Lead the planning and execution of customer programs, ensuring milestones, deliverables, and outcomes are consistently met.
Translate customer objectives into structured program roadmaps with clear success criteria, timelines, and ownership.
Manage program governance including progress tracking, status reporting, risk management, and escalation handling.
Coordinate program kickoffs, milestone reviews, and closeout activities.
Maintain thorough program documentation — plans, RAID logs, decision records.
Customer Relationship Management
Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customers, building strong, trust-based relationships.
Ensure ongoing alignment between customer goals and Elovate 's solutions and service delivery.
Provide customers with regular program reviews, data-driven performance insights, and strategic recommendations.
Proactively identify and address customer concerns before they become escalations.
Partner with customers on program expansions, renewals, and long-term roadmap planning.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Facilitate collaboration across Product, Operations, Field Service, and leadership to drive successful program delivery.
Coordinate internal resources and manage competing priorities to meet customer commitments.
Champion the customer voice internally to influence product improvements and service enhancements.
Partner with Sales and Customer Success leadership on account strategy and growth opportunities.
Performance & Continuous Improvement
Define program success metrics and KPIs; track and report on outcomes against targets.
Proactively identify opportunities to improve processes and strengthen customer partnerships.
Conduct post-program reviews to capture lessons learned.
Contribute to scalable program management frameworks, templates, and best practices.
Analyze program data to surface trends, risks, and opportunities for operational improvement.
Stakeholder Communication & Reporting
Develop and deliver clear, concise program status updates tailored to both operational and executive audiences.
Maintain a regular cadence of customer and internal communications.
Prepare program reviews, executive briefings, and customer-facing reports that demonstrate program value and impact.

5+ years of experience in program or project management, customer success, consulting, or related roles.
Demonstrated ability to lead complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives from concept through completion.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple programs simultaneously.
Excellent communication and facilitation skills with experience engaging senior stakeholders.
Proven track record of building and maintaining strong customer relationships.
Analytical mindset with the ability to define metrics, measure progress, and report outcomes.

PMP, PgMP, or equivalent project/program management certification.
Experience working with municipal or government agency customers.
Background in automated traffic enforcement, public safety technology, or SaaS/hardware service delivery.
Familiarity with program management tools such as Smartsheet, Asana, or Monday.com.
Experience with contract management and SLA oversight.
AI & Technology
Elovate encourages Program Managers to leverage AI tools to work more efficiently, communicate more effectively, and deliver greater value to customers.
Use AI-assisted tools to streamline program documentation — status reports, RAID logs, executive summaries, and customer-facing communications.
Leverage AI analytics to monitor program health, identify schedule risks early, and surface data-driven insights for customer reviews.
Apply AI tools to synthesize customer feedback, meeting notes, and program data into actionable recommendations and lessons learned.
Stay current on AI tools relevant to program management and customer success, bringing relevant capabilities to your workflows.
Apply sound judgment when using AI-generated outputs — validating all customer-facing content before delivery.
About Elovate
Elovate , a Modaxo company, has been a trusted partner to municipalities and state agencies for over 30 years. We deliver data-driven automated traffic enforcement solutions — covering speed, red light, school zone, and work zone safety — designed to prevent dangerous driving behaviors before they lead to incidents.

Our mission is simple: protect lives and create safer roads for the communities we serve. As part of Modaxo, a global collective of people-movement technology companies, we combine deep industry expertise with innovative technology to make meaningful, lasting impact.

As Biogen ’s Associate Director, Access Management Service Delivery- Cyber Security, you are the Access Management subject matter expert and services leader for all Access Management activities at Biogen . This role is accountable for delivering value to global stakeholders – which includes access services to every application in Biogen .

A peer to this role is the Service Delivery Manager of Identity. This role is a direct report of the Global Leader of Identity and Access Management and is a member of the extended leadership team within the Cybersecurity organization.
As Associate Director, Access Management Service Delivery, you are responsible for establishing access management policies and standards and keeping them current.

You are responsible for the planning and execution of initiatives that improve access management capabilities – both central platforms or efforts supporting independent stakeholder applications.

This role is responsible for the entire service delivery process, from planning and implementing service strategies to monitoring and reporting on service performance. Long-term, the largest lever to improve service delivery is through automation into target applications.

While >95% of access transactions originate through our Biogen Access Management (BAM) platform, less than 25% are fulfilled through automation. In other words, 75% of requests require manual fulfillment by independent application teams.

In the near-term, this role will work with their peer in Identity to automate the onboarding, lifecycle and deprovisioning of all types of privileged accounts. This is done manually today via BAM requests and for security’s sake, deserves to be automated.

A long-term objective for this role is to work with the application owners across Biogen to adopt access automation. This role manages the performance of an integrated team, ensuring that service delivery meets or exceeds stakeholder expectations.

You will serve as the business process owner for access management policy, standards and processes which includes:
Authorization (Permissions): Determining what an authenticated user is allowed to do. Common models include:
RBAC (Role-Based): Access granted based on job functions (e.g., "HR Manager").
ABAC (Attribute-Based): Access based on dynamic factors like location, time of day, or device security posture.
Administration (Lifecycle Management): Managing the full lifespan of a digital identity, from provisioning (creation) and maintenance (role changes) to deprovisioning (deletion when a user leaves). Auditing & Reporting (Accountability): Tracking and recording user activities to maintain a clear audit trail.
